'''Ulaire Cantea VSC - Watch Your Step, The Grounds A Little Wet''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ulaire Cantea]]
* '''Published:''' 28 March 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 WYS Cantea LS 2002 VSCWatch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Great WYS deck, it'll work great. Just trust me...

The published list has 68 cards.

== Strategy ==

Ok, this is a basic WYS deck. You just play people to the sites you have out, destroy them with mad destinies, and run when you need to.  Defensive Shields were a nice addition, especially for this particular deck. With them, you dont have to worry about much.  THis deck does fine against basically everything except Lightsaber combat, then it will be a tough match.  Other than that, everything is pretty self explanatory.  The New cards (labeled NEW) are great too, they can really help.Any questions, dont put it in the rating, email me and i can explain.

THanks!

Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar

Rogue Five
